faq.q: What does the name Aalaa mean?

faq.a: Aalaa is used in Arabic, Urdu.

faq.a: Aalaa is used as a female name.

faq.q: How is Aalaa written in Arabic and Urdu?
faq.a: Aalaa is written آلاء in Arabic and آلاء in Urdu, and आला in Devanagari.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aalaa?
faq.a: The root of Aalaa is آلاء (ālāʾ).

Does Aalaa appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: The word ālāʾ ('blessings') occurs in the Qur'an; it is used as a personal name.
No. Ālāʾ means 'blessings, bounties'. The gloss 'mountain' relates to a different Arabic word (jabal).

faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aalaa total 7, reducing to 7. Number 7 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.a: Aalaa appears with variants and alternative spellings such as Aala, Alaa.

faq.q: Which names are related to Aalaa?
faq.a: Names sharing form or root with Aalaa include Aala, Aali.

faq.q: Where is the name Aalaa used today?
